newsitem.title: UK: Boots remains soft after CEO stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Boots remains soft after CEO stock sale.

text.p: Shares in British pharmacy group Boots Plc lagged behind a broad stock market rally on Thursday, weighed down by news of a stock sale by the group's chairman and chief executive and negative comments by brokerage SBC Warburg, dealers said.
By 1340 GMT, the shares were off 1/2p to 734-1/2, well off the day's worst level at 723, as the FTSE 100 rebounded, gaining 28.9 points to 4,753.7.
Dealers noted a disclosure late Wednesday that Boots chairman and chief executive Lord Blyth of Rowington sold 150,000 shares in the UK retailer.
Dealers said SBC Warburg told its clients to follow the chairman's move.
SBC Warburg's analyst couldn't immediately be reached for comment. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
